It's not that at all. I unlocked Requital by defeating Villainous Infinitor (and he never flipped, either). My last move was a 22-point Construct Cataclysm (boosted thanks to Parse) that took down Infinitor. We've also seen several different environments (I was in SIlver Gulch, someone else was on a MDP).

Remember how, when we were dealing with XPWCC, we thought it had to do with having one of each Construct type in play? I suspect that may be it this time.

But it appears to be:

Win a game against Villainous Infinitor with base Captain Cosmic on the team. [Something else.]

posts.cooked:
Unlocked

Villain - Infinitor

Environment - Final Wasteland

Heroes - Legacy, Visionary, Fugue State Parse, Captain Cosmic (in that order)

CC did most of the damage, though everyone did some.  CC got the final blow, with a Construct Cataclysm of 4 constructs.  All of Infinitor's Manifestations were seen and destroyed.  NOT all of CC's constructs saw play (I know for a fact that Wounding Buffer did not see play)

My idea for unlock conditions are...

Defeat Infinitor with Captain Cosmic present.  CC must get the final blow.  No Constructs or Manifestations can be in play at game's end.

posts.name: Ensign53
posts.cooked:
Unlocked, first attempt.

Infinitor vs base CC, grandpa legs, PW fanatic, team leader Tachyon, and XPW AA (all for extra card draw and funnel most powers to CC)

Edit: fought at the Block.

Won with CC using construct cataclysm to deal final blow.

All constructs and manifestations were out of play. Saw all at least once.

Other heroes did kill manifestations, including environment killed at least 1.

No incaps.

CC cycled through deck at least once, so did infinitor.

Much healing was had by grandpa legs, gung-ho, and motivational strike, and cosmic crest.

My guess for unlock conditions:

defeat infinitor with construct cataclysm. Every unique manifestation must have been played and beaten at least once. Every unique construct must have been played and destroyed at least once.
